scope: Limit of the evaluated certified-profile candidate and audited native mechanisms in SDK/runtime 1.0.4258.31 / 154.0.4258.62 X64; not a theorem about every hypothetical WebView2 configuration.

blocker.channel: WebRTC ICE/STUN direct UDP to controlled loopback canary, outside HTTP proxy
blocker.notAQuicClaim: These packets are positively identified STUN, not HTTP3/QUIC.
blocker.reason: Normative WebRTC-disabled and no relevant direct UDP requirements are contradicted by an owned native process in a valid secure context. IP-handling switch/readback is insufficient; no OS/global firewall or JS wrapper substituted.

serviceWorkerCounterexample.nativeFilter: WebResourceRequested '*' All contexts + All source kinds, deny Service-Worker script header or ServiceWorker source
serviceWorkerCounterexample.context: WebView2 virtual-host mapped HTTPS controlled context; no TLS error needed
serviceWorkerCounterexample.limitation: Mapped resource route did not emit the blocking callback for these script loads. This refutes exhaustive SW-off for this candidate; it does not prove that remote network script blocking can never work.
serviceWorkerCounterexample.workerFetchExercise: Fixed worker calls fetch on execution and when serving cache; network counters do not certify external egress because these resources were mapped locally.

unprovenAreas.HTTP_HTTPS: First auth NavigationCompleted failure was consumed before auth-triggered renavigation; navigation helper is not NavigationId-correlated. No positive end-to-end renderer/TLS proof. Do not attribute these failures to product.
unprovenAreas.logicalAdmission: Native URL and frame denials observed, but redirects/second origin/reuse/coalescing not successfully exercised. No overall PASS.
unprovenAreas.dns: Calibrated UDP canary was not system resolver. Native netlog+snapshot metadata are insufficient to exclude all useful DNS.
unprovenAreas.proxyAuth: One exact proxy challenge received credentials in candidate-v3, none exposed to site; destination auth challenge test did not reach fixture, so isolation is not fully proven.
unprovenAreas.quic: Kestrel/MsQuic capability present; Alt-Svc page did not successfully load through authenticated proxy. No separate QUIC PASS from UDP silence.
unprovenAreas.TLS: Exact fixture-pin mechanism coded test-only; no successful validation callback/rendered response observed. Not a certificate-validation or trusted-HTTPS PASS.

stopReason: Concrete normative essential-channel violation demonstrated; no further profile changes/hardening/probes authorized by this result.
